Run Pre-Flight Air-Gap Isolation and Integrity Verification

Source: R/container.R
preflight_isolation_check.Rd

Validates container hardening posture (--network none, --read-only, --cap-drop ALL, no-new-privileges, pinned image SHA-256 digest, loopback host binding), confirms that any runtime endpoint is strictly loopback / local Unix socket / offline mock, optionally verifies local model weight SHA-256 digests on disk, checks outbound proxy environment variables, and returns a cryptographically hashed (and optionally HMAC-signed) pre-flight verification record.

Usage

preflight_isolation_check(
  spec = NULL,
  endpoint = NULL,
  model_path = NULL,
  expected_model_digest = NULL,
  allow_internal_network = FALSE,
  check_proxies = TRUE,
  strict_proxy = TRUE,
  allow_symlinks = FALSE,
  signing_key = NULL,
  error_on_fail = FALSE
)

Arguments

spec

Optional airgap_container_spec() object.

endpoint

Optional character URL or airgap_runtime object.

model_path

Optional local path to model weights to verify on disk.

expected_model_digest

Optional expected SHA-256 digest for model_path. Defaults to spec$model_digest when available.

allow_internal_network

Logical scalar; if FALSE (default), requires spec$network_mode == "none". If TRUE, also permits network_mode == "internal" when host_bind is strictly loopback.

check_proxies

Logical scalar; inspect outbound proxy environment variables (HTTP_PROXY, HTTPS_PROXY, ALL_PROXY, FTP_PROXY, SOCKS_PROXY, case-insensitive). Defaults to TRUE.

strict_proxy

Logical scalar; if TRUE (default), active outbound proxy variables without explicit 127.0.0.1 and localhost entries in NO_PROXY cause pre-flight verification to fail closed. Set to FALSE to downgrade proxy exposure to an advisory warning.

allow_symlinks

Logical scalar passed to verify_model_digest() when verifying model_path. Defaults to FALSE.

signing_key

Optional secret key (character or raw) to attach an HMAC-SHA256 attestation signature to the verification record.

error_on_fail

Logical scalar; if TRUE, aborts with an airgap_isolation_error when any required check fails. Defaults to FALSE.

Value

An S3 object of class "airgap_preflight" with passed, status, checks (tibble), spec_digest, model_digest, endpoint_class, checked_at, record_hash, and signature.

Examples

spec <- airgap_container_spec(
  backend = "ollama",
  image_digest = paste0("sha256:", strrep("a", 64)),
  model_dir = "/srv/models"
)
pf <- preflight_isolation_check(spec = spec, endpoint = "http://127.0.0.1:11434")
pf$passed
#> [1] TRUE
